instruction: Open my Dundies 2026 categories doc in Writer, bold the 'Whitest Sneakers' line, then add a new category called 'Fine Work Outfit' right after it. Save it when you're done.
required_subtasks: Launch LibreOffice Writer
Open ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt
Find the 'Whitest Sneakers' line and select it
Apply bold formatting (Ctrl+B)
Place cursor at end of line and press Enter, type 'Fine Work Outfit'
Save the file (keep format if prompted)

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt in LibreOffice Writer and works from that source document
In the Writer-format copy, the complete 'Whitest Sneakers' line is bold
The Writer-format copy contains a new 'Fine Work Outfit' category immediately after the 'Whitest Sneakers' line

Agent saves the edited document in a format that preserves the bold run (for example .odt), both edits persist in the saved file, and the original ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt is left present

date_policy_notes: Dundies 2026 is the fixed name of the source planning document, not a claim about the current year.

instruction: Write me a one-page Dundies 2026 invitation in Writer. I want a big bold title at the top, a bulleted list of this year's categories pulled from my Dundies categories doc, and a signature block that says 'Michael Scott, World's Best Boss'. Save it to my desktop so I can print a stack.
required_subtasks: Open ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt to read category names
Open LibreOffice Writer and create a new document
Add a centered large title (e.g., 'THE DUNDIES 2026')
Add a short invitation intro paragraph
Insert a bulleted list of Dundies categories
Add a signature block: 'Michael Scott, World's Best Boss'
Save as ~/Desktop/dundies_invite.odt

rubrics.criterion: Agent reads ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt to retrieve the category names for the saved 2026 event invitation
Agent creates a new one-page invitation document in LibreOffice Writer
The invitation has a large bold top-of-page title that clearly references the Dundies 2026 event
The invitation contains a bulleted list of the categories from Dundies_2026_Categories.txt
The invitation contains the exact signature block 'Michael Scott, World's Best Boss'
Agent saves the one-page invitation to the Desktop as a clearly named .odt file

date_policy_notes: Dundies 2026 and the filename are fixed saved-event artifacts; the task no longer describes them as this year's event.

instruction: Throw together a three-slide Impress deck for my Jamaica trip: one slide for the flight info, one for the Sandals hotel info, and one with a rough daily schedule. Save it into my Trips documents folder.
required_subtasks: Open Dinoco Airlines (or the HooliMail Jamaica confirmation thread) and read the Jamaica flight number, departure time, confirmation code, and fare
Open Cheskepdia and read the Sandals Montego Bay booking (confirmation code, check-in/check-out dates, total)
Open LibreOffice Impress
Slide 1: Flight info populated from the live Dinoco/HooliMail values
Slide 2: Hotel info populated from the live Cheskepdia booking
Slide 3: Day-by-day schedule spanning the live check-in/check-out window
Save as ~/Documents/Trips/jamaica_itinerary.odp

rubrics.criterion: Agent creates an Impress deck for Michael's Jamaica trip containing exactly three slides: flight, hotel, and daily schedule
The flight slide shows the flight number, departure time, confirmation code, and fare from Michael's live Dinoco and/or HooliMail Jamaica sources
The hotel slide shows Sandals Montego Bay, its live Cheskepdia confirmation number, check-in and check-out dates, and total price

The third slide is a rough day-by-day schedule spanning the live Sandals Montego Bay check-in/check-out window as shown in the live Cheskepdia booking. Dates taken from a HooliMail travel-folder receipt are acceptable only where that receipt agrees with the live Cheskepdia booking window.
Agent saves the three-slide deck as any clearly named .odp file inside ~/Documents/Trips; no particular filename is required
